purpose: City-specific registry and public parcel-geometry source review. No owner, address, tax, or private property fields were requested or retained.
assessment: UP land-record mapping is available by district, tehsil and revenue village. Official Ballia dashboard reports georeferenced map-sheet/village coverage across tehsils, but is aggregate coverage and does not establish a vector parcel endpoint at this locator. The viewer’s plot lookup is identifier/map-click oriented; only raster map output was verified in this review. No geometry feature was retained; geometry evidence remains unverified.
